**The Cleveland Browns have secured a major piece of their defense with the signing of Denzel Ward to a 2-year extension worth $62.2 million, making him the highest paid cornerback in the NFL.**

## Context / Background
The Browns have been working to solidify their roster for the upcoming season, and this move is a significant step in that direction. Denzel Ward, a key player in the Browns' secondary, has been a crucial component of the team's defense since his arrival.

## Tactical Key Points / Stats Table
| Category | Stat |
| --- | --- |
| Contract Length | 2 years |
| Contract Worth | $62.2 million |
| Annual Salary | $31.1 million |

> The signing of Denzel Ward to this historic extension demonstrates the Browns' commitment to building a competitive team around their core players.

## What's Next?
With this extension in place, the Browns will look to build on their defense, potentially making moves to strengthen other areas of the team. The focus will now shift to how the team performs on the field, with the upcoming season promising to be an exciting one for Browns fans.
